page.layout: One column of index entries down the left side of the scan, one entry per line, with a few stray numbers between entries. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is visible in this part.; One index page, cut at the left edge. Left: fragments of index entries (word ends, cut off). Right: columns of page references, one line per entry, with the left fragment on the same line where it is visible. Running head "I N" at the top.; One column of index entries, alphabetical, with page numbers at the right; the column runs to the foot of the scan. Running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.
page.notes: The scan is cut at the right, so the page numbers and references after each entry are not visible; only the words are transcribed. Several entries are cut short by the scan edge and are marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "cenfor", "celfus" and similar forms appear as censor, celsus and so on. The stray numbers 299 and 569.77 stand alone between entries and may be page references or a fragment of a printed number. The left-hand words are cut off at the edge of the scan, so only their final letters are visible; they are copied as far as they show. Some left-hand fragments may sit on a neighbouring line; the alignment of a few fragments with their numbers is approximate. Right-hand edge of the scan is dark; the lower part of the page is not visible. "Chriftus" and "Chryfoprafus" are printed with long s and are given here with plain s. "iconia" is printed with a dropped c and is read as "ciconia".
